newsitem.title: SOMALIA: Kidnapped aid worker released in Somalia - family.
newsitem.headline: Kidnapped aid worker released in Somalia - family.

text.p: An aid worker for a Swedish group who was kidnapped in north Mogadishu six weeks ago was freed unharmed on Saturday after payment of a ransom, sources close to his family said.
Hilal Mohamed Aden was seized at his house by unidentified gunmen and taken to the south part of the divided Somali capital on September 19.
He works for the Life and Peace Institute of Sweden. No details were available of the ransom paid.
Last month non-governmental aid agencies in Mogadishu announced they were suspending "non-vital" aid operations until he was freed.
